name: Canonical Single-PR Dry Run
scope: Make plain single-PR --dry-run the canonical non-mutating pre-merge validation path.
Return validated_dry_run with explicit not-executed merge and post-merge phases.
Report behind heads as would-update without mutating or retrying.
Prove mutation absence, flag equivalence, movement safety, and unchanged live behavior.
acceptance_tests: npm.cmd run check:paragraph-lane-scope -- --lane shared --base origin/main --head HEAD
forbidden: No Lesson repository or generated lesson-output change.
No product, engine, source-data, rendered-output, or Y1 evidence change.
No protected machine or external reference change.
No branch-protection, authorization-model, authority, merge, or administrative-bypass change.
